title.description: Game name, shown on the title screen.

icon.description: The game's icon: assets/ui/<icon>.png, square, 256x256 or larger. The desktop app's exe and window icon and the web build's favicon.

version.description: The game's version, like "1.0" or "1.2.3": the desktop app's version info. Separate from saveVersion.

id.description: Key for saves, settings and read-text tracking. Defaults to a slug of `title`. Changing it starts with fresh saves.

engine.description: Minimum engine version, e.g. "0.1". The tools warn when the engine is older.

stage.description: The stage size in pixels (default 1920x1080). Screens, hotspots and image coordinates are in these pixels; reload the preview after changing it.

titleScreen.description: Title screen. Preview it from "Built-in screens" in the Files panel (or Ctrl+Enter in this tab).

background.description: Scene name drawn behind the menu (assets/bg/<name>.png).

music.description: Looping track for the title screen (assets/music/<name>.*).

showTitle.description: Show the game name (turn off when the background art has a logo).

align.description: Where the title and buttons sit.

buttons.description: Buttons in order. Leave one out to hide it.

fade.description: Seconds of black between the title screen and the game, both ways (0 = cut).

intro.description: A script label played once when the game starts, before the title screen (a cutscene; finish it with `end`). Esc skips it. Preview with the "Intro" command.

splash.description: Logo cards shown once when the game starts, before the title screen. Click or Enter skips a card. Preview with the "Splash" command.

duration.description: Seconds the card stays fully visible.

fade.description: Seconds to fade in, and again to fade out.

anchors.description: Extra named anchors for "anchor=<name>" on show and move: the point a character scales, turns and mirrors about, as [fx, fy] fractions of its sprite (0,0 top left, 1,1 bottom right). Built in: feet [0.5, 1], center [0.5, 0.5], head [0.5, 0.1], top [0.5, 0].

additionalProperties.description: [fx, fy]: across (0 left, 1 right) and down (0 top, 1 bottom) the sprite.

positions.description: Extra named stage positions for "show ... at <name>" and "move ... to <name>": 0 is the left edge, 1 the right edge. A position can also set a height ({ "x": 0.7, "y": -0.15 }; negative lifts) that a line's own y= overrides. Built in: left (0.2), center (0.5), right (0.8).

anyOf.description: Across the stage, 0 (left edge) to 1 (right edge).

x.description: Across the stage, 0 (left edge) to 1 (right edge).

y.description: Height offset as a fraction of the stage height; negative lifts the character. Used by show and move unless the line has y=.

saveVersion.description: Raise this when a release breaks old saves: loading a save made under a lower number asks the player first.

choiceSaves.description: How many rotating choice autosaves to keep (the "C" page of the Load screen).

saveNames.description: The player names a save when making it in a numbered slot (the name shows on the save screen in place of "Slot 3"), and can rename it there. Auto, quick and choice saves are never asked for a name.

voiceLanguages.description: Languages to record voice in (e.g. ["ja", "fi"]), listed in the Voice dialog and held to having a recording for every spoken line by the build checks, even before the first recording. Separate from the text translations in locale/<lang>.json. The source language is the default take and needs no entry.

language.description: The language the scripts are written in (default "en"). Other languages are translations in locale/<lang>.json. Players pick the text language, and separately the voice language, in the options.

memoryBudgetMB.description: Memory budget for loaded images and audio, in MB (default 512, 256 on low-memory devices). The debug console command memory reports against it.

quickMenu.description: The quick menu bar shown while playing.

items.description: Buttons in order; leave one out to hide it, use [] for no bar. Hotkeys work either way.

gallery.description: Gallery entries (a Gallery button appears on the title screen). Each unlocks when its image has been shown while playing, or by "unlock <flag>".

image.description: Background name (assets/bg/<image>.png), e.g. a CG shown with "scene".

unlock.description: Unlock with this flag instead (script: unlock <flag>).

musicRoom.description: Music room tracks (a Music button appears on the title screen). Each unlocks once it has played while playing, or by "unlock <flag>".

unlock.description: Unlock with this flag instead (script: unlock <flag>).

chapters.description: Chapter select (a Chapters button appears on the title screen). Each starts a new playthrough at a label; it unlocks once the story has reached the label, or by "unlock <flag>".

unlock.description: Unlock with this flag instead (script: unlock <flag>).

achievements.description: Achievements and endings (an Achievements button appears on the title screen). Each unlocks when the script runs "unlock <flag>", and pops up a toast.

anyOf.description: A flag (script: unlock <flag>), also the title.

unlock.description: The flag that unlocks it (script: unlock <flag>).

description.description: What it is for; hidden ones show it only once unlocked.

icon.description: Image: assets/ui/<icon>.png, on the list and the toast.

ending.description: An ending: listed and counted apart from the achievements.

toast.description: false: unlock it quietly, with no toast.

achievementToast.description: The stock toast an unlocked achievement pops up. Declare "screen achievement_toast" to draw your own (seconds and sound still apply).

speakerFocus.description: Dim the characters who are not speaking. true for the defaults; players can turn it off in Options, scripts with "focus off", one character with "define ... focus=off".

dim.description: How much darker the others get (default 0.35).

front.description: Draw the speaker in front of the others for the line (default false).

offstage.description: When the speaker is not on stage (narration): everyone lit (default) or everyone dimmed.

sideImages.description: The speaker portrait in the text box, for characters defined with "side=<name>" (assets/side/<name>.png, or <name>_<pose>.png while they are on stage in that pose). true for the defaults.

place.description: Which end of the text box (default left).

when.description: always (default), or only while the speaker is not on stage.

pwa.description: The web export becomes an installable, offline app: a web manifest and a service worker that keeps the whole game on the player device (default false; it can be a lot of data).

touch.description: Touch screens (docs/game-json.md). Players can still switch gestures off in Options.

gestures.description: Swipe right = back, up = history, down = hide the interface; long press or two-finger tap = pause menu (default true). false for a game whose own screens need those swipes.

blips.description: Text sound voices by name. Built in: high, mid, low, soft, typewriter, robot (a voice here with the same name replaces it).

additionalProperties.description: A text sound voice. Use it with `define <char> ... blip=<name>`.

pitch.description: Synth pitch in Hz (440). Lower for deeper voices.

vowels.description: Vowel mode: a sample per vowel (assets/sound/<name>).

mode.description: letters: a blip per letter. vowels: only on vowels, pitched per vowel.

labels.description: Menu label text in the source language. Other languages: "ui.<key>" in locale/<lang>.json.

theme.description: The name of a theme file: "night" uses themes/night.json.

order.description: Part names bottom to top. Listed parts swap among the positions they hold; the rest stay where the PSD had them.

items.description: A slot, or a plain layer's file name without .png.

bones.description: The bone tree: transform nodes with a parent and a pivot. A key or `animate ... part=` naming a bone moves it and everything below it.

parent.description: Another bone; without one the bone hangs from the character.

pivot.description: Where it turns, [x, y] in pixels of the PSD canvas. Without one: its parent's.

tip.description: Where the bone ends, [x, y] in pixels of the PSD canvas. Moves nothing: it shapes auto-weights for skinned meshes.

parts.description: Which bone each part sits on (and a pivot of its own for a part that must turn about another point than its bone's). A name that is no part of the PSD is a shape part: give it a "polygon".

pivot.description: A pivot of its own, when it must turn about another point than its bone's.

clip.description: The shape part or image part this part is clipped to.

polygon.description: A shape part (it has no art): its outline, points [x, y] in pixels of the PSD canvas.

follow.description: A shape part: the image part whose drawn mesh bends it.

keyforms.description: A shape part: per-vertex displacements driven by parameters.

pivot.description: A pivot of its own, when it must turn about another point than its bone's.

clip.description: The shape part or image part this part is clipped to.

polygon.description: A shape part (it has no art): its outline, points [x, y] in pixels of the PSD canvas.

follow.description: A shape part: the image part whose drawn mesh bends it.

keyforms.description: A shape part: per-vertex displacements driven by parameters.

pivot.description: A pivot of its own, when it must turn about another point than its bone's.

clip.description: The shape part or image part this part is clipped to.

polygon.description: A shape part (it has no art): its outline, points [x, y] in pixels of the PSD canvas.

follow.description: A shape part: the image part whose drawn mesh bends it.

keyforms.description: A shape part: per-vertex displacements driven by parameters.

bone.description: The bone this shape part sits on.

pivot.description: A pivot of its own, when it must turn about another point than its bone's.

clip.description: The shape part or image part this part is clipped to.

polygon.description: A shape part (it has no art): its outline, points [x, y] in pixels of the PSD canvas.

follow.description: A shape part: the image part whose drawn mesh bends it.

keyforms.description: A shape part: per-vertex displacements driven by parameters.

looks.description: Named maps from slots to variants for `show` (`show mina shy casual`): later looks win per slot, and slot=variant on the show line wins over all. A variant of none hides the slot.

look.description: Another look, applied first: one of these looks, or a layer name or alias from the PSD.

pivots.description: Where a part turns and scales from, in pixels of the PSD canvas ([x, y] from the top left). Without one it is the middle of the part's image.

animations.description: Keyframe animations for `animate <char> <name>`. A name equal to a preset (bob, sway...) replaces it for this character.

dur.description: Default length in seconds (1 when left out); `animate` can give another.

auto.description: When the animation starts by itself: "every" (a random or fixed wait after each run) and/or "while" (it loops while the condition holds). "behaviors off" in the script suspends it.

every.description: Seconds to wait after each run: { "min", "max" } for a random wait, or one number for a fixed wait.

while.description: A condition in the script's expression language: story variables, speaking (one of its lines is typing), always, param.<id>.

params.description: Parameter tracks: a parameter id to its keys { t, v, ease }.

frames.description: Frame tracks: a slot swapped between variants as the animation runs.

physicsOff.description: While it plays, the physics chains are bypassed: true for all, or the listed chain ids.

keys.description: Keys at progress t (0-1), empty for an animation of parameters or frames only. Each channel is eased between its own keys and is 0 at both ends unless a key says otherwise.

part.description: Move this part of the character (about its pivot) instead of the whole body.

x.description: Sideways offset, as a fraction of the stage height.

y.description: Vertical offset, as a fraction of the stage height (negative = up).

scale.description: Added to the size: 0.05 is 5% bigger.

opacity.description: A factor on the alpha: 1 as drawn, 0 gone. Rests at 1 (not 0) at both ends.

ease.description: Easing of the way to this key (default inout).

reactions.description: Poses the character holds while a condition is true. The first entry whose "when" holds wins; none holds: the parameters return to what the script set.

when.description: A condition in the script's expression language: story variables, speaking, always, param.<id> (a parameter's base value).

over.description: Seconds the move into the pose takes (default 0.4).

categories.description: The Parameters panel's groups, in order: a parameter or pad names one in its "group".

parameters.description: Named scalars that drive keyforms and poses.

pads.description: 2D controls over two parameters: a UI grouping only.

poses.description: Named snapshots of some parameters ({ "happy": { "mouth_smile": 1 } }), set with `show <char> pose=happy`.

keyforms.description: Authored poses of a bone or part at chosen parameter values, blended.

deformers.description: Lattices that warp a part's mesh (or a group of parts), driven by parameters.

mesh.description: A free mesh in place of a lattice: verts, tris, and optionally bone weights.

defaultBone.description: The bone a vertex without weights binds to (a skinned mesh).

weights.description: Skinning: vertex number to { bone: weight }, at most 4 bones, normalized when read. A vertex not listed binds to defaultBone. The part's own bone does not move a skinned mesh.

physics.description: Secondary motion: chains by id, reading parameters or bone channels and writing parameters or a part's rotation.

extends.description: Another theme file (its name) or the built-in "base"; values here win.

fonts.description: A font per language code, e.g. {"ja": "Noto Sans JP"}; replaces font and uiFont in that language.
